I decided to break the ice, by speaking about my own family first. I named my mother Strokey, because eventually she has a series of strokes that basically ruin her "adult" life. I know, super creative. This will also show you a glimpse into why I am such an idiot when it comes to dealing with narcissists. This also gives you a glimpse into what it was like for my future DH and my future X. I feel bad for them having to put up with my mother.

Please note: Most of this later information, I just recently found out. It took over 20 years for my dad to finally open up about a lot of things that happened due to the parental alienation that STILL affects all of us kids. You just get an insider's glimpse at what was really going on. Try not to feel too bad for him though, because he was a douche growing up.

We're going to rewind to around when I was 15, and starting the process of trying to escape my mother. My parents were in the middle of their divorce, and I had just gotten my license. The original rule was that when ALL of the kids became of age to drive, we would receive a car. It wasn't going to be a brand new shiney car, but a usable car.

My brother received a brand new car (not surprising, he's the golden child). I was to receive mine next (black sheep). I didn't get a brand new car like I was hoping for. I got a piece of junk that I could barely turn the steering wheel (alignment issues that couldn't be fixed), and a passenger side door that wouldn't open (younger sister/friends couldn't get in due to the prior owner's previous accident). Basically, it was a piece of crap and ready to die at any moment. It cost about $500 total to buy.

I was working 3 jobs and attending high school at the same time. One of those jobs was working on the shore, at a conference resort, as their audio/visual engineer. (For those wondering this was in NJ, where I grew up) I basically only slept about 2 hours per day, and ran that car into the ground just by using it. I almost never slept at home, or I had nightmares. I spent a ton of time sleeping in little "safe" spots in my car at night (places my mom wouldn't find me). Most of my time was spent working, going to school, and raising my sister. My brother is mostly out of the picture at this point, because he has a new girlfriend (that later cheats on him after they get engaged and attend college together - with his best friend. I actually saw this coming and tried to warn him) and he cares more about that than anything else.

I said earlier that my mom has 7 sisters (2 dead) and 1 brother (dead now). All of them are divorced and are wise to the process of it. Don't get involved with these people, they all have something wrong with them. My mother tapped all of their brains to basically screw my dad, and screw him she did. You get to see the whole picture of it all right now, my dear little friends, due to recent updatedness from my dad.

During the divorce, my mom was actually doing a lot of shady things that I didn't find out about until a few months ago. Strokey went for full custody of all 3 kids (my brother was 18 and newly off to college - so no child support for him, my sister was 14 and pregnant tho no one knew yet) and she wanted spousal support/alimony plus child support. She also wanted the house. That house would later sell for 1.5 million dollars, though I was told it went into foreclosure (sold for nothing and putting her in debt, so she said) and she lied to me about it. (Dad showed me the paperwork ~2 years ago, my mom was rolling in the cash and made roughly 500k off of the house alone. Not including her settlement for his IRAs, etc, another 350k. She was rolling in the money.)

She claimed that my dad was NOT paying the mortgage on said house, and that since I was living in it - I needed to pay for it or we'd lose it (she didn't tell me it was actually going to be sold while we were living in it!). My dad actually was paying the mortgage, but I'm a teenager and didn't know that. I wasn't allowed to contact my dad, so I just forked over majority of my paychecks to her ($1,500 a month for those wondering). Mind you: during this time, my mom wasn't actually LIVING in the house with my sister and I. She had abandoned us to live with her new boyfriend (a theme of hers that she continued until her strokes) upstate and was basically spending the REAL mortgage money on her boyfriend and HIS kids. Awesome mom I had, seriously. I was left to raise my sister by myself, whom was a narcissist in training.

Okay, so my mom wants full custody. I'm a normal teenager and have no idea how a divorce is going to go. My mom tells me not to go into the court room and testify because it will be "scary". Strokey regales us with horror stories of her own court appearances. She tells all of us kids that my dad owns a gun now, and he has threatened to kill us all (not true, and no my dad doesn't own a gun). She gets a temporary restraining order placed on him and he's thrown in jail overnight. Hence I can't call him to confirm/deny anything she is telling me, due to the no contact order.

She hands my sister and I a printed out piece of paper that is half written on it, stating we don't want to go into the court room. Okay, I read it and sign it. Turns out, later, she filled out the rest of the paper with a bunch of nonsense and our signatures onto the bottom of it. It said in her words: we don't want to live with my dad. (Dad later tells me what was said on it and why he didn't go for custody anymore after seeing that paper)

In reality, I really DID want to live with my dad. My mom and I are like oil and water. She treated me like garbage, and our living situation was less than stellar. My sister, didn't want to live with my dad. But, if I wasn't "living with" my mom then my mom wasn't going to be getting $2,500 from her child support for me. (Noticing a theme? Most of the people in my life are greedy)

The divorce goes through. I don't get to see my dad until I am around 17 yrs old and that was only because it was my birthday. I am told via Strokey that this is because my dad wanted absolutely nothing to do with me. I am constantly told that the divorce was because of me (my attitude, etc) and that my dad hates me. My siblings start to resent me because of this and they kind of still do. (I still have the reputation that I have a temper, which I don't. I'm a slow to boil pot, and then I erupt after numerous things have happened after long periods of time. My mom actually had me convinced for 25 years that I was a super emotional person, whereas everyone else in my life that met AFTER escaping her has nicknamed me as having a heart of ice. I'm just not really an emotional person unless you push me for a long ass time. That just goes to show how mind-bending she was.)

I'm told later that my dad spent over $30k in legal fees to try to get custody of us, or at least me. He said that he knew I was depressed and basically being responsible for everything in his absence. He became aware of the jobs/money I was giving my mom through my brother (18 and she couldn't get a restraining order for him because he wasn't under age). He also said that he started sending Strokey extra money so that I wouldn't have to pay for the mortgage anymore (it was really funding her boyfriend's bitch kid to party it up). My dad tried everything he could to try to change the situation I was in, unbeknownst to me. I won't find this out until 20 years later though.

My dad also put aside college money for all of us kids, but during the divorce MY college money and my sister's college money is given to Strokey for safe keeping. Can you guess what happened to that? Yeah, I have no clue either. I had to pay for my own college out of pocket. My dad paid for ONLY my brother's college, and we're pretty sure Strokey spent all of mine. I'm actually told during the time that my dad refused to pay for my college because I "have demons inside of me". (This is something my mom tried to convince my dad of right before the divorce, and she tried to suffocate them out of me. This is also why my dad realized he needed to get divorced, because she was basically trying to kill me every day.)

So, at 17, my mom is still living with her boyfriend upstate and doting on his kids. My sister has now had her child at the ripe age of 15 and dropped out of high school. I am helping my sister raise her kid, because my sister is basically my mom but mini-version. I'm still paying the mortgage, but my mom has added on the bonus of paying for the electricity too ($300 a month). My sister keeps stealing from my mom, and myself. I am losing roughly 90% of my paychecks between the two of them. Awesome.

The car dies. Triple awesome. I go to my mom and tell her that I need to get a new car that will stand the test of time. She takes two weeks to finally come down and help me.
